rows.coder_note: 'Mastitis data were obtained from FinnGen (2,468 cases; 258,508 controls)': endpoint-level counts with the cohort name alone; no release number, and the counts are not a release-defining N of any FinnGen row (rules D, I1).
'an Icelandic GWAS ( n = 35,559)': the N equals that of deCODE SomaScan v4 (Ferkingstad 2021), but no platform, year, citation or accession stands with it; N alone is insufficient (rule I1).
'a UK Biobank genome-wide association study (GWAS) ( n = 54,219)': cohort name with an N that is no dictionary row's sample size; no citation, subcohort, platform or accession (rules D, I1).
